# apple_nominations (Data Source)

Lists the account's featuring nominations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_nominations" "drafts" {
  states  = ["DRAFT"]
  app_ids = [data.apple_app.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_ids` (Set of String) Only nominations of one of these apps.
- `states` (Set of String) Only nominations in these states; all states when unset. Values: `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`, `ARCHIVED`.
- `types` (Set of String) Only nominations of these types. Values: `APP_LAUNCH`, `APP_ENHANCEMENTS`, `NEW_CONTENT`.

### Read-Only

- `nominations` (Attributes List) The nominations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nominations))

<a id="nestedatt--nominations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nominations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the nomination.
- `name` (String) Name of the nomination.
- `state` (String) State of the nomination.
- `type` (String) Type of the nomination.
